# Download videos from X, YouTube, TikTok and Instagram with yt-dlp

**A link becomes a local MP4, MP3 or playlist from 1,800+ sites, or Pinterest images from a pin, board or search query.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_5ec6a143fa1e.webp" alt="A downloaded NASA clip plays: an astronaut drives a lunar rover across grey regolith, then a technician in a clean suit works at a lab bench." width="480"><br><sub>Footage: NASA (public domain)</sub></p>

Download videos, audio and images to local files from a link. Video and audio come from X/Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, Reddit, Vimeo, LinkedIn, Twitch, VK, Rutube, Bilibili, Dailymotion and the 1800+ other sites yt-dlp supports. Pinterest images come from a pin, board, profile or a plain search query, which is useful for moodboards and visual references. Use when the user pastes a link and wants to download, save or grab it, wants its audio, metadata or a whole playlist, or wants Pinterest pictures or references for a style. Runs locally; no account or API key. Triggers: "скачай видео", "скачать по ссылке", "скачай с пинтереста", "собери референсы", "download this video", "save this reel/tweet/short", "rip the audio", "pinterest moodboard".

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill media-download                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills media-download --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Download this video: https://x.com/someone/status/1234567890"
- "Save the audio of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123 as an mp3"
- "Grab 30 Pinterest images for 'film noir portrait' into ./refs for my moodboard"
